Fixed model assumptions

Reference departure: 2026-10-28T18:00:00Z (Wednesday, 12:00 MDT). Solo ordinary private passenger car; no permits or HOV exemption; tolls allowed. Vehicle dimensions are unspecified, so unknown clearance controls remain unsupported.

Conditions are frozen for the entire route. Times use static posted limits or declared defaults, with no traffic, waiting or arrival-time access reevaluation. America/Denver is a declared research timezone assignment. Conditions may change before arrival.

Starts are unconstrained native road nodes; connector approach histories and costs are excluded. A route may end inside an ONLY prefix under the retained solver policy. Context-point displacement is not connector cost. Forty finite results among five hypotheses do not supply a uniform destination-window bound or a complete metro anchor set.
